全拉时保留轻拉: Keep soft pull at full travel
全拉时替换轻拉: Replace soft pull at full travel
快速全拉跳过轻拉，慢拉可叠加: Skip soft pull on a quick pull, combine stages on a slow pull
仅快速拉到底触发全拉: Full pull only on a quick pull
轻拉立即响应，快速全拉时替换: Respond to soft pull immediately, replace it on a quick full pull
轻拉立即响应，仅快拉可切换: Respond to soft pull immediately, allow full pull only on a quick pull
在动作里分别选择 LT 或 RT 的轻拉和全拉。全拉点取决于校准后的最大行程。: Choose soft or full pull for LT or RT in an action. Full pull uses the calibrated end of travel.
旧版配置及内含的关联文件会一起转换。: The legacy profile and its included files will be converted together.
可以粘贴配置，或选择文件。主文件引用的配置可作为关联文件添加。: Paste a configuration or choose a file. Add files referenced by the main configuration as related files.
双段扳机模式不支持改变虚拟扳机的输出方向: Two-stage trigger modes cannot reroute a virtual trigger
轻拉阈值必须在 0–1 之间（不含 1），或为 -1 表示随扳机移动触发: Soft pull threshold must be at least 0 and less than 1, or -1 to trigger from movement
快速全拉时间窗必须在 0–5000 毫秒之间: The quick full pull window must be between 0 and 5000 milliseconds
旧版 JSM 配置需要转换。请在「导入 JSM 配置」中选择此 TOML 文件: This legacy JSM profile needs conversion. Select this TOML file under Import JSM profile
请选择 JSM 主配置文件: Choose the main JSM configuration file
旧版配置已包含关联文件，请单独导入: Import the legacy profile on its own. It already contains its related files
请选择旧版 JSM 原文配置: Choose a legacy JSM profile file
旧配置的虚拟手柄输出或透传规则需要手动核对。: Review virtual controller output and passthrough for the legacy profile.
已在这里展开选中的关联文件: Expanded the selected related file here
未迁移此命令。主文件引用的配置可作为关联文件添加: This command was skipped. You can add files referenced by the main configuration as related files
虚拟扳机透传模式下的绑定需要手动核对: Review bindings used with virtual trigger passthrough
已保留全拉绑定。请在扳机设置中启用该侧的全拉模式: Full-pull binding was retained. Enable full pull for this trigger in trigger settings
